correctness.rationale: The lifted Markov state is (Xt,Xt-1), transitions (a,b)→(x,a) with q_ab∈(0,1). Stationary equal pair probabilities p01=p10=s imply π0=A/(A+B),π1=B/(A+B). First-positive-passage recurrences h1=1+(1−q_ab)h1(0,a), h0=1+q_ab h0(1,a) solve to displayed 4×2 tables; weighted differences factor exactly π1(u−v)^2/u and π0(w−z)^2/(1−z). Positivity makes both zero iff u=v and w=z. Conversely first-order Kemeny identity yields 1+1/(u+1−w), verified by substitution. Independently solved rational sample (u,v,w,z)=(1/2,1/4,1/2,3/4) obtaining θ=(49/22,95/44,57/22,119/44), defects (3/44,5/44). Input verify.py separately solves the stationary and two hitting linear systems; no extension to nonpositive boundary tensors.
